concerns.text: The plan’s Phase Mapping (Section ‘Phase Mapping (Coverage of FRs & SCs)’) references contracts only for StructuralRecord (via validation step) but does not exercise the defined `policy_head.schema.yaml` or `adapter_output.schema.yaml` contracts, leaving those schemas unused.

The benchmark step logs latency and memory but does not specify generation of an `AdapterModelOutput` CSV that would be validated against `contracts/adapter_output.schema.yaml`; this disconnects the plan from the data model’s third entity.
